title: ENDOWWERT
text: ENDOWWERT, in law, denotes the fetting a dower on a woman : though femetimes it is ufed, fi- guratively, for fetting a provilion upon a parison, on the building of a cahrul; or the foresee a sufficient portion of tithes for a viera, when the benefice is ap- propagated.
